exposure: Flint River water exposure (pre, during, and post periods)
cohort: The study included females of childbearing age (12-50 years) living within and adjacent to Flint, Michigan, whose geocoded blood lead levels were available from a single hospital database.
finding: Blood lead levels in Flint females of childbearing age did not significantly increase during the Flint River water exposure period compared to the pre-exposure period, and post-exposure levels were significantly lower than both pre and during levels.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for three 18-month time periods: April 25, 2012-October 15, 2013 (PRE), April 25, 2014-October 15, 2015 (DURING), and April 25, 2016-October 15, 2017 (POST) relative to the Flint River water switch.
